response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p INNER JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_site_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: Passing the threshold means RAM usage greater than 60.8 GB; a zero CPU usage makes the ratio missing.

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold is inclusive, so records using exactly 60.8 GB also qualify.
